content: cmdk ecosystem is fork-fragmented for React 19: original pacocoursey/cmdk had Radix peer-dep friction; maintained forks cmdk-base (ports cmdk onto Base UI Dialog) and dip/cmdk exist, plus independent react-cmdk. Single-source finding, not cross-checked — supporting color only; the recommendation (hand-rolled palette on the project's existing Base UI dialog) rests on the local csv.ts hand-rolled precedent, not on this claim.
